description: This file defines the class ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy, which handles the command to modify or create a feature property within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains logic for applying feature property modifications, size validation, and generating appropriate events and responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the modification or creation of feature properties within a Thing entity, responding to ModifyFeatureProperty commands, generating events, and performing validation.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method that applies the modify feature property command, performing size validation, feature extraction, and result generation.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specified feature from the given Thing object based on the command.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify an existing feature property or create a new one, returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result representing a modified feature property event.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result representing a created feature property event.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the previous entity tag for the feature property, based on the previous Thing state.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the entity tag for the new feature property value.
